summary: Implementation has 5 BLOCKER-level issues preventing deployment: TypeScript compilation failures (Prisma type discovery), zero test coverage, no event emission from domain, unauthenticated frontend, and no durable delivery/retry mechanism. While backend service structure is well-organized, the system cannot function in production.

blockers.title: TypeScript Compilation Failure
blockers.description: 24+ Prisma type discovery errors block build. Property 'notification', 'userNotificationPreference', 'notificationDelivery' do not exist on PrismaService despite schema being present and client generation succeeding.
blockers.remediation: 1. Verify Prisma Client output location matches TypeScript include paths. 2. Regenerate client: rm -rf node_modules/.prisma && npm run generate. 3. Check tsconfig.json includes Prisma types.

blockers.title: Domain Events Not Emitted
blockers.description: No bid.accepted, break.started, break.ended, auction.ended, subscription.expiring events are emitted from AuctionsModule or SubscriptionsModule. NotificationService has no @OnEvent() listeners wired. EventEmitterModule registered but no publishers.
blockers.impact: Notifications cannot be triggered in production; system is non-functional
blockers.remediation: 1. Add event emission to AuctionsModule bid settlement, break state changes, auction conclusion. 2. Add listener for subscription expiry events. 3. Wire @OnEvent() handlers in NotificationService. 4. Test event flow end-to-end.

blockers.title: Zero Test Coverage (Requirement: 85+)
blockers.description: Backend placeholder test contains only expect(true).toBe(true). Frontend has no notification tests. No behavioral tests for channels, delivery, rate limiting, preferences, or workflows. Requirement specifies 85+ unit/integration/E2E tests.
blockers.impact: Zero confidence in correctness; authorization gaps undetected; error handling untested
blockers.remediation: 1. Write 60+ unit tests: NotificationService, adapters, preferences, rate limiting. 2. Write 20+ integration tests: database, authorization. 3. Write 5+ E2E tests: auction workflow. 4. Achieve 85%+ coverage.

blockers.title: Frontend Not Authenticated
blockers.description: Pages /account/notifications and /account/settings/notifications are unauthenticated Pages Router routes outside App Router shell. No JWT guard on components or pages. Hooks make API calls without credentials.
blockers.impact: CRITICAL SECURITY ISSUE: Unauthenticated users can view other users' notifications; data exposure vulnerability
blockers.remediation: 1. Move routes to App Router (src/app/account/notifications). 2. Add AuthProvider around pages. 3. Add authentication guard on components. 4. Verify JWT in hooks. 5. Test unauthorized access returns 403.

blockers.title: No Durable Delivery or Retry Mechanism
blockers.description: Dispatch uses setImmediate() with no durability guarantee. NotificationDelivery records created but never consumed. No background job calls getPendingDeliveries() or incrementAttempts(). Transient failures (network, rate limit) are terminal. Process exit loses pending notifications.
blockers.impact: Failed emails/SMS are permanent; rate-limited SMS never recover; high failure surface with zero resilience
blockers.remediation: 1. Implement transactional outbox or durable queue. 2. Add background retry job consuming PENDING deliveries every 5 minutes. 3. Implement exponential backoff (max 3 attempts, then mark FAILED). 4. Or defer to Phase N.3 and document as deferred.

high_priority_issues.title: JWT Identity Resolution Invalid
high_priority_issues.description: @CurrentUser('sub') returns Cognito ID, not internal User.id UUID. Controllers use as direct Prisma query key. Cross-user access undetected.

high_priority_issues.title: Frontend Accessibility Missing
high_priority_issues.description: Toggle switches lack role, aria-label, checked state. Clickable divs lack keyboard handlers. Dropdown doesn't manage focus. No ARIA labels. No prefers-reduced-motion support.

high_priority_issues.title: PII Leaks & HTML Injection
high_priority_issues.description: Logs expose email and phone numbers in full. Email HTML not escaped (markup injection). TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER unset defaults silently.

high_priority_issues.title: Frontend Not Responsive (Requirement: 375px–1440px)
high_priority_issues.description: No responsive layouts. Fixed multi-column grids break on mobile 375px. No breakpoints or CSS Grid.
